messages:
Maya Patel: Quick question — bought a local SIM at AMS for a 5-day customer trip. Total €45 (SIM + data top-up). Used ~2 days for work calls and the rest personal. Receipt attached. Can I expense the full amount or do I need to split? Any policy on telecom purchases at airports?

Juan (People Ops): Yep — telecom (SIM/data) is reimbursable when it's business-critical, but we ask for a few things. Short answer: you should claim the business portion and include the itemized receipt + manager approval.

Maya Patel: Cool. Do I need preapproval for the amount? It was a one-off at the kiosk, didn’t think ahead.

Juan (People Ops): No retro preapproval required for small telecom purchases, but if > €75 we ask you to get a quick sign-off in #people-ops or from your manager. Also code it to `mobile-internet` (expense category).

Oliver Kim: I reviewed — 2 days were work calls, approved for the work portion. @Maya please put that in the expense notes so accounting can pro-rate. :thumbsup:

Maya Patel: Got it — how should I pro-rate? By days used for work vs total days? Or by data usage?

Elena (Accounting): Days-based pro-rate is fine and preferred for privacy (we don’t ask for call logs). So in this case: 2/5 = 40% business. Claim 40% of €45 = €18. Attach the receipt and a brief note: “2/5 days business — approved by Oliver Kim”.

Finance Bot: Reminder: upload the original itemized receipt (photo/pdf). If your card charged in non-EUR, we will use the card transaction rate on the statement for conversion. If you paid cash, choose currency EUR and we’ll use the rate on the expense date per accounting policy.

Juan (People Ops): A couple of extra rules to avoid surprises:
- Airport kiosk receipts must show itemized purchase (SIM/data) — a generic card slip without item details may be rejected.
- If the SIM purchase included a device or line extension > €150, that needs preapproval and asset tagging.
- If mixed personal/business, always include manager attestation in the notes.

Maya Patel: OK — receipt is itemized. I paid cash but have the vendor receipt. I’ll attach and note the pro-rate + Oliver’s approval. Anything else (VAT reclaim?)

Elena (Accounting): Good Q — we only reclaim VAT for telecom purchases if the vendor issues a VAT invoice in the company name. Airport SIM kiosks rarely do that. If you can’t get a VAT invoice, submit the expense normally; VAT won’t be reclaimed. No extra action needed on your part.

Juan (People Ops): For reference, policy snippet: telecom & mobile data reimbursable when needed for customer work, receipt required, pro-rate personal use, preapproval for purchases > €75. Link: <https://redwood.company/policies/expenses#telecom>

Maya Patel: Thanks all — submitting now with 40% claim and Oliver’s confirmation in notes. :pray:

Oliver Kim: Thanks Maya — approved.

Elena (Accounting): Received — I’ll process with 40% and mark as non-VAT reclaimable. Will post if any follow-up needed.
